name: token-tracker
description: Local Oh My Pi and Cursor token usage, spend and provider quotas in a VS Code panel

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension.js && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('media', { force: true, recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('../web/out', 'media/web', { recursive: true })"
